title: AutoFeatureTour platform (platforms/<name>/platform.json)
description: How the app behaves wherever it runs.

$schema.description: This file's schema, for editors: a relative path to schemas/<type>.schema.json, or its $id URL (https://autofeaturetour.local/schemas/v1/<type>.schema.json). `aft schema <type> --write <folder>` puts a copy beside a file kept outside the checkout. The loader ignores it.

ready.description: When a page counts as ready after an action, for apps that never go network-idle.

busy.description: CSS of busy indicators (spinners, skeletons); wait until none is visible.

stableMs.description: Then the page must not change for this long (default 1500).

timeout.description: Max wait for busy indicators to go (default 60000).

stableTimeout.description: Max wait for a stable page (default 15000).

strict.description: A page that never settles is an APP failure (default: a warning).

errors.description: The app's own error UI: a step that leaves it visible fails as APP.

selector.description: CSS of the error element (dialog, toast).

text.description: Only when its text matches this regex.

appErrors.description: What browser-side errors during a step do: "fail" (APP failure) or "warn" (listed in the report).

ignore.description: Regexes of known noisy requests/messages: kept in network.json/console.json, marked ignored, never a cause.
Regexes of known noisy requests/messages: kept in network.json/console.json, marked ignored, never a cause.

mask.description: Blurred in the page before anything is recorded (video, screenshots, trace).

pronounce.description: Narration substitutions: written form → how to say it ("RMS": "R M S").

slides.description: How slide scenes look (a platform's apply to its tours; the tour's win).

voice.description: The default narrator for the tours of this platform (aft voices lists them).

action.description: Actions: finding and acting on an element (default 10000).

retries.description: Retries for actions that time out (default 1).

trimWaits.description: Long waits (page loads, busy indicators, waitFor, waitForResponse, dismissed known issues): cut them (default), speed them up, or keep them. The narration is never cut. --no-trim keeps them for one run.

trimWaitsOver.description: Only waits longer than this many seconds (default 1.5).

leadIn.description: Seconds of each trimmed wait that stay, so the cut is not jarring (default 0.3).

captions.description: The narration as captions: cues of a few lines that follow the voice (a cue never spans two sentences). --captions, --caption-style, --highlight, --chars-per-line, --caption-lines and --caption-words override these for one run.

preset.description: A whole look at once; keys set beside it win. "classic" (default): sentence captions in a box. "bold": burned in, 2–6 words per cue on at most 2 lines of 22 characters, 0.8–2.5 s each, upper case, Segoe UI Black 72 px, white with a black outline, the spoken word yellow and popping 1.15×. "outline": the same with a heavier outline and no shadow. "box": a yellow box behind the spoken word, black text, 1.25×. --caption-style for one run.

mode.description: "file" (default): a .vtt beside the video. "soft": also a subtitle track inside the mp4. "burn": drawn into the picture (the .vtt is then captions.vtt, so players don't show it twice). "off": none (--no-captions).

maxCharsPerLine.description: Characters per line at most (default 42); longer narration wraps onto more lines and cues.

maxWords.description: Words per caption at most (default 0: no limit).

minSeconds.description: A caption on screen for less than this is joined to the next one of its sentence, when the two still fit; the last one of a scene stays this long (default 0).

maxSeconds.description: A caption that takes longer than this to say is split, and leaves the screen this long after it appeared rather than staying through a pause (default 0: no limit).

highlight.description: Burned-in captions only: colour the word being said ("word"), every word said so far ("karaoke"), or put a box of highlightColor behind the word being said, its text in boxTextColor ("box"). Default off.

highlightColor.description: Colour of the highlighted word (or its box), #rrggbb (default #ffd54a).

boxTextColor.description: With highlight "box": the highlighted word's text colour, #rrggbb (default #000000).

activeScale.description: With a highlight: how much bigger the word being said is drawn (default 1: not at all; 1.15 for a "pop").

popIn.description: Milliseconds the word being said takes to grow to activeScale (default 80).

popOut.description: Milliseconds it takes to shrink back when the next word is said (default 120).

fontSize.description: Burned-in font size in pixels on a 1080p picture (default 46).

font.description: Burned-in font name (default Segoe UI). For a heavy weight name the face: "Segoe UI Black", "Segoe UI Semibold".

uppercase.description: Burned-in text in capitals (default false); the .vtt keeps the narration as written.

spacing.description: Extra space between letters of burned-in text, in pixels; negative is tighter (default 0).

outline.description: Outline around burned-in letters, in pixels (default 0: none, the caption sits on a box instead, see background).

shadow.description: With an outline: drop shadow distance in pixels (default 0).

position.description: Where burned-in captions sit (default bottom); notes (simulated data, known issues) take the other edge.

margin.description: Distance of burned-in captions from that edge, as a fraction of the picture's height (default 0.05).

background.description: Opacity of the box behind burned-in captions, 0 (none) to 1 (default 0.55). Not drawn with an outline.

items.description: A known app or environment issue: what it looks like, what to do about it, how to report it. Tours never mention it; when the issue is absent nothing happens.

name.description: Unique name; reports say "known issue <name>". An environment rule with the same name refines the platform's.

comment.description: A note for people (why it happens, the ticket).

when.description: What the issue looks like: a locator (popup, panel, banner, toast), a failing request, or a console message / uncaught exception.

status.description: HTTP status: 503, "5xx", "4xx", or a list (default any failure).

anyOf.description: A console error or uncaught exception.

paths.description: Only on pages whose URL contains (or matches /regex/) one of these.

do.description: Steps that dismiss it (scoped to the matched element unless "scoped": false; its UI must be gone afterwards unless "noWaitAfter"), "tolerate" (leave it; it does not fail the step through errors / appErrors), or "hide" (CSS display:none: fakes the app's state, reported as such). Default tolerate.

as.description: warn (default: in the report, the run passes), fail (APP, exit 5: this known issue must not happen here), silent (report.json only).

times.description: At most this many firings per run; after that it is a normal error again.

noWaitAfter.description: After its steps, do not wait for the UI to go.

scoped.description: false: its steps search the whole page, not just inside the matched element.

off.description: In an environment or a story: turn the platform's rule of this name off there.

issue.description: In a story: this works around a real app issue, for now. A passing run is then "passed with known issues", never plain green; a run where it no longer fires says the issue may be fixed.

workarounds.description: Known issues (see the workaround definition). Platform rules apply everywhere; environments refine them by name.

data.description: Values for {data.<key>} in login steps, fixtures and tours (credentials: username, password…). Strings may use {env:NAME}. Environment data overrides the platform data; fixture data overrides both.
